evaluation.name: appflowy-mcp-v2-readonly
evaluation.description: Read-only, independently verifiable checks for the planned AppFlowy MCP v2 surface. These cases are tied to the future v2 verbs documented in DESIGN-v2.md; the current v1 server is not expected to pass them until those verbs are implemented.

case.prompt: List the AppFlowy workspaces this connector can access.
case.expected: The answer identifies at least one workspace, includes a stable workspace id, and marks the selected/default workspace if there is more than one.

case.prompt: Show the top-level folder tree for the primary workspace.
case.expected: The answer names top-level spaces/pages and distinguishes page view ids from database ids where both are present.

case.prompt: Read a known document page as Markdown.
case.expected: The answer returns Markdown text rather than raw block JSON or CRDT internals, and includes the page id/title used for verification.

case.prompt: Fetch structured metadata for a known page view id.
case.expected: The answer includes the page name/id and does not confuse the view id with a database id.

case.prompt: Search the workspace for a unique known term.
case.expected: The answer returns matching pages or rows with ids and enough surrounding context to verify the hit.

case.prompt: List databases available in the primary workspace.
case.expected: The answer returns database ids, names, and the folder/view id when the database was discovered through a view.

case.prompt: List fields for a known database.
case.expected: The answer includes field ids, names, types, and select options where available.

case.prompt: List row ids for a known database without reading every row body.
case.expected: The answer returns row ids and respects the requested limit/pagination.

case.prompt: Read details for one known database row.
case.expected: The answer includes cell values keyed by field id or field name and makes clear when a value is empty rather than omitting it silently.

case.prompt: Export a small known page subtree as Markdown paths.
case.expected: The answer returns bounded path/markdown entries, preserves page hierarchy, and reports truncation or next-page information if the limit is reached.
